result.summary: The image shows a commercial street with a signalized intersection that lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. The wide, unmarked roadway and parked vehicles near the corner create visibility and safety concerns for people crossing.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No visible pedestrian signal heads to indicate when it is safe to cross at a signalized intersection.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parking
hazards.description: Parked cars close to the intersection corners block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals and improve safety at the signalized intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten crossing distances, slow turning traffic, and improve visibility.

result.summary: This signalized intersection lacks fundamental pedestrian infrastructure, including marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals. The wide, unmarked roadway and vehicles parked close to the corners create significant visibility issues and increase exposure risk for people crossing.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings at the intersection to designate a safe crossing path or alert drivers to pedestrian presence.

hazards.name: Missing pedestrian signals
hazards.description: The intersection has vehicular traffic lights but no dedicated signals for pedestrians, forcing them to guess timing based on car movements.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light poles at the corners

hazards.name: Sightline obstructions
hazards.description: Vehicles parked right up to the intersection corners block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Curbside parking near the intersection corners

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra or ladder-style pavement markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at corners to reduce crossing distance and prevent parking too close to the intersection.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban street with a signalized intersection and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure is present, the faded crosswalk markings and significant crossing distance without a median or curb extensions increase pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The roadway is wide with no refuge island, increasing the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic.
